Chapter 625: Chapter 43 Mysterious Emperor Lineage (Please Subscribe)_2

The six-armed silhouette spoke with a sense of emotion.

“Not a single creature?” Lin Yuan looked somewhat puzzled.

The ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path, although abstruse and difficult to understand, could still be comprehended by a Ninth Rank powerhouse if they forcibly meditated on it, it would just take more time.

Back when Lin Yuan was in the Seven Star Cave World, he had comprehended the ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path in not very long a time.

“Indeed.”

“The ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path, created by His Majesty, can only be comprehended by those lives whose foundations are not yet set.”

...

“Once the foundation is set, even if it’s ultimate, it can’t be comprehended.”

The six-armed silhouette slowly said.

What does setting the foundation mean? According to the definition of human civilization, that would be the Sixth Rank.

To step into the Sixth Rank, one must determine their core evolution path and achieve a complete integration with their own soul.

Theoretically, every Sixth Rank powerhouse has already confirmed their foundation.

Of course, even if the foundation is set, it can still be changed at a cost, and those Sixth and Seventh Rank Evolvers of human civilization have attempted to switch to other evolution paths.

But, according to the six-armed silhouette, the prerequisites to comprehend the Mysterious Yellow Evolution Path are exceptionally stringent; once the foundation is set, it cannot be comprehended.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan’s expression cleared, no wonder the Chikun Star Lord, having obtained the Mysterious Yellow Evolution Path for hundreds of thousands of years, had still reaped no results—the reason lay here.

“Actually, I can sense that, outside the secret realm, there are still some creatures who have cultivated the Mysterious Yellow Evolution Path to the beginner level, but they are too weak and don’t even qualify to feel the calling…”

The six-armed silhouette sighed.

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Mysterious Yellow Evolution Path, Lin Yuan was not the first to comprehend it; ten thousand years ago, that little disciple of the Chikun Star Lord also comprehended the Mysterious Yellow Evolution Path.

However—

The growth of a powerhouse is filled with ruggedness.

To qualify to enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, one must at least be an invincible Eighth Rank, and most powerhouses who enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm are even Ninth Rank.

And how many lives are required to give birth to one Ninth Rank? One hundred million? One billion? Ten billion? One hundred billion? One trillion?

Far more than that.

Chikun Star Domain possesses over one million life planets, and by the standards of Canglan Star, with a permanent population of fifty billion, that would be five trillion citizens.

In reality, the actual number of citizens in the Chikun Star Domain is far more, with citizens on some higher life planets far exceeding this figure.

Not only are citizens dwelling on life planets, but some resource planets and special planets also have a large number of citizens residing permanently.

However, since the opening of the Chikun Star Domain, not a single Ninth Rank powerhouse has been born.

To enter the Mysterious Yellow Evolution Path, the most crucial point is the alignment with this evolution path.

This alone screens out the vast majority of people, leaving only a few evolvers who barely comprehend it and want to continue practicing up to Seventh Rank, Eighth Rank, or even Ninth Rank.

It is no exaggeration to say that it is as difficult as ascending to the heavens.

Most importantly, the vast majority of powerhouses, upon discovering they cannot comprehend the Mysterious Yellow Evolution Path, would no longer pay attention to it. As with the Chikun Star Lord, very few place great importance on the Mysterious Yellow Evolution Path.

And even if they value it, it’s useless unless they cultivate to the invincible Eighth Rank or even Ninth Rank.

These restrictive conditions, each one on its own, might appear to be not absolutely impossible, but when combined… one can tell from the tone of the six-armed silhouette.

Since the opening of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Lin Yuan was the first.

“But luckily, I have waited for you,” the six-armed silhouette looked at Lin Yuan and slowly said.

“Are you a Supreme Being?” Lin Yuan thought for a moment and voiced his doubt.

“I am not a Supreme Being,” the six-armed silhouette paused slightly, shaking its head as it said, “I am just a consciousness formed by this secret realm.”

“A consciousness formed by the secret realm?” Lin Yuan pondered a moment and then understood.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm, although called a secret realm, could truly be regarded as a world, and the so-called consciousness formed by the secret realm is akin to a world consciousness, an existence like the Heavenly Dao.

In the Tianqing World, Lin Yuan replaced the world consciousness with the consciousness of the Ancestral Demon Tree, becoming the Heavenly Dao of that world.

Over the years, the consciousness of the Ancestral Demon Tree had been carrying out the commands left by Lin Yuan.

The presence of the six-armed silhouette was probably the same, carrying out the orders left by Emperor Xuanhuang over the long years.

“Originally, His Majesty created 33,333 Xuanhuang secret realms and left corresponding heritages; it’s hard to know how many still remain…”

The six-armed silhouette spoke with a tone tinged with reminiscence.

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan couldn’t help but be astounded.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which even Supreme Beings couldn’t pinpoint, numbered at thirty-three thousand, three hundred and thirty-three?

Lin Yuan was very aware of the depth of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which was better described as the Xuanhuang World rather than just a realm, with foundations far surpassing the Xuanhuang World of the World of Gods.

“But all that is in the past. After His Majesty disappeared, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm lost its source of power and will gradually decline. Without your arrival, in a few tens of billions of years, or even half a Cosmic Era, I would completely fall into a deep sleep,” he said.

The six-armed silhouette said.

Tens of billions of years?

Lin Yuan looked at the six-armed silhouette.

But for an eternal and immortal Supreme Being, tens of billions of years indeed didn’t amount to much.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was established by His Majesty Xuanhuang. If nothing went wrong, it should last eternally along with His Majesty Xuanhuang.

Not just the world, but even the universe will one day decay; this is the origin of the Cosmic Era.

The internal universe of a Supreme Being can last eternally because they regularly intervene and make adjustments.

“It doesn’t matter if I fall into a deep sleep or even perish, but His Majesty’s heritage, His Majesty’s hard work, must not disappear,” said the silhouette with an inexplicably resolute tone.

Lin Yuan listened quietly, knowing he didn’t need to ask why the six-armed silhouette had summoned him here.

Lin Yuan didn’t believe that the call from the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, spanning countless light-years, was just to let him hear someone’s ‘complaints’?

“You might have guessed already that the call from your own path of cultivation on the ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path is because anyone who succeeds in entering the Mysterious Yellow Evolution Path can be considered as His Majesty’s successor,” the silhouette said.

“But to inherit His Majesty’s true mantle, being a successor is far from enough,” said the six-armed silhouette, looking at Lin Yuan. “You must pass the numerous challenges set by His Majesty.”

“Understood,” said Lin Yuan.

The owner of the Demonic Jade Tower with its Nine Floors Dark Tower also required overcoming each floor to receive the corresponding reward.

Lin Yuan was already familiar with this.

Even in human civilization and among the various peak clans, obtaining anything required passing certain challenges.

“What challenges do I need to pass?” Lin Yuan immediately asked.

“Which challenges?” The six-armed silhouette fell silent, casting an unusual glance at Lin Yuan.

“His Majesty set sixty-eight lower challenges, twenty-five medium challenges, and six high challenges…”

“Only a life form that passes all the challenges could inherit everything within this secret realm, from the Mysterious Emperor Lineage,” continued the silhouette, pausing for a moment. “But for you, there’s no need for such trouble.”

The six-armed silhouette gazed at Lin Yuan. As the ‘Heavenly Tao’ of this secret realm, nothing Lin Yuan did within the realm could be concealed from it.

Aside from anything else, just the number of spatial layers Lin Yuan occupied left the six-armed silhouette utterly astounded.

This Xuanhuang Secret Realm could only allow Eighth Layer invincibles and Ninth Rank beings to enter,

Thus all challenges set by His Majesty Xuanhuang were aimed at Ninth Rank life forms.

But Lin Yuan?

What challenges could be set for him?

What could test him?

“No need for such trouble?” Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow.

“Correct,” the six-armed silhouette replied, waving its right hand and producing a yellowish-brown crystal in front of him.

The aura of the brown crystal was exceptionally pure, greatly surpassing the Xuanhuang Crystal, and it was faintly connected to the entire Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Looking at Lin Yuan, the six-armed silhouette said:

“You only need to refine this Core of the Secret Realm to become the new master of this place. Everything within the secret realm, including all the treasures and heritages of the Mysterious Emperor Lineage, will be yours.”
